limitations: This is the complete rank-one skeleton and minimal-nonzero-ideal structure, not a classification of the full inverse monoid at n>=3. The underlying framework predates 2026 through arXiv:2301.04252; the named distinct motivating article was submitted April 28, 2026.
scientific_integrity: A theorem and derivation for all prime powers and every matrix dimension n>=3; finite exhaustive generator-domain checks supplied for n=2,3 at q=2,3. No independent audit or priority certification.
title: The rank-one Brandt skeleton of finite matrix partial-inner monoids
